Technomancer.name: 科技法师 Technomancer
Technomancer.description:
你知道，魔法与科技都是同一套代码的一部分——一套你已经学会破解的代码。你精通一种魔法编程语言，能够将你的装备超频，使其获得更高的性能与多样性。你已经学会为你的法术越狱，让你的魔法突破极限。你来到这里，就是为了破解现实。

You know that magic and technology are all part of the same code—a code you've learned to hack. You're versed in a magical programming language that allows you to overclock your equipment into higher performance and versatility. You've learned to jailbreak your spells, pushing your magic past the limits. You're here to hack reality.

Mechanic.name: 技师 Mechanic
Mechanic.description:
说到科技，你的理解无人能及。你不断制造并改装装备，无论是计算机、爆炸物、工具、武器，还是你自行设计的物品。你构建了一个精密的外脑皮层，这是一种定制的神经植入体，将你的思维与你最复杂的造物连接起来：一个机器人同伴、一座武器炮塔，或遥控地雷。要是有什么东西坏了——或者需要被弄坏——那就得靠你了。

When it comes to tech, your understanding is unmatched. You're constantly crafting and modifying gear, whether that's computers, explosives, tools, weapons, or items of your own design. You've constructed a sophisticated exocortex, a custom neural implant linking your own mind to your most complex creation: a robot companion, a weapon turret, or remote mines. If something's broken—or needs breaking—you're the one.
